Audiences\n   are specs like `friends:vk & chat:vk:2000000001 - list:blocked`\n   (union, intersection, difference), saved and resolved anywhere.\n4. **Reply graph** (`js/src/replies/`). Every (incoming message → our\n   reply) pair is a link with a count; the composer first offers every\n   reply used before for the chat's last message, deduplicated and most\n   used first, then word-by-word completion from the owner's own\n   messages. It learns from imported archives and in real time. A\n   link-cli (`clink`) database mirrors the graph\n   (`reply-store-clink.js`, `MS_REPLY_CLINK=1`).\n5. **Storage**: `doublets-archive.js` writes records as a deduplicated\n   doublets network in the link-cli binary archive layout\n   (`clink --import-binary` reads it), and `lino-store.js` keeps the text\n   half as one links-notation record per line (`lino-objects-codec`).\n6. **Delivery and typing** (`js/src/sources/`). VK, Telegram and\n   WhatsApp adapters show our typing status, and VK long-poll typing\n   events show the other person's; `browser-sender.js`\n   sends through vk.com, web.telegram.org and web.whatsapp.com via\n   browser-commander when the API throws or is not configured.\n7. **Front ends.** The **Chat** tab (t3.codes-like by default) has a\n   ⚡ Automations menu in every chat, the drafts, typing indicators and\n   suggestions; the **Automation** tab edits, previews and runs\n   automations, searches people and saves audiences; **Settings →\n   Appearance** chooses system / light / dark / auto (by the hour) and\n   the t3.codes, Telegram, WhatsApp or Signal skin. The `automations`\n   CLI and `/api/automations`, `/api/people`, `/api/audiences`,\n   `/api/lists`, `/api/send`, `/api/typing`, `/api/suggest` routes cover\n   the same ground; the SPA falls back to its local links offline.\n8. **Dependencies**: every npm package and GitHub Action at its latest\n   release (eslint 10, jscpd 5, React 19.3, playwright 1.64,\n   browser-commander 0.31, links-notation 0.25, …).\n\n## Local Artifacts\n\nRaw GitHub data is preserved under `data/`: `issue-31.json`,\n`issue-31-comments.json` (none), `pr-34.json`,\n`pr-34-conversation-comments.json` (the review that started the second\nround is the comment of 2026-10-11T17:26:45Z), `pr-34-review-comments.json`\nand `pr-34-reviews.json` (none).\n\nScreenshots under `screenshots/` were taken with Playwright against\n`experiments/automations-spa-server.mjs`, which seeds a store (Telegram\n\"Аня\" on \"ты\" and VK 2002 on \"вы\", both silent for months; its output is `verification-logs/automations-cli-roundtrip.log`.\nThe `experiments/clink-*.mjs` probes measure link-cli's query and import\ncosts that shaped the reply store.\n\n## Root Questions and Answers\n## Solution Plan\n\nSee [`solution-plan.md`](./solution-plan.md).\n\n## External Research\n\nSee [`external-research.md`](./external-research.md) — deep links that\nopen a chat (RFC 6068, Telegram, VK) and how VK peer ids encode the\nchat type.\n\n## Known Limits\n\n- Telegram contacts imported from an export are numeric ids, so the\n  \"Open chat\" link is `tg://user?id=…`, which opens the chat but cannot\n  prefill text. Telegram does document a prefilled link for usernames\n  and phone numbers (`t.me/<username>?text=…`), which can be used once\n  an importer records usernames.\n- Address-form rules cover Russian, Chinese and Hindi. Other languages\n  with a T–V distinction (German du/Sie, French tu/vous, …) can be added\n  as `pattern:*` links without code changes, but none ship by default.\n- Web UI sending depends on each site's markup (`WEB_UIS` in\n  `browser-sender.js`); a redesign of vk.com, web.telegram.org or\n  web.whatsapp.com needs that table updated. It is tested against a fake\n  browser session, not against the live sites.\n- Only VK reports when the other person is typing. The Telegram Bot API\n  and WhatsApp Cloud API deliver no typing events to bots or business\n  numbers, so there the chat shows our own typing only.\n- WhatsApp Cloud API ties typing indicators to the incoming message\n  being answered, so it can only show typing in a reply.\n- The link-cli mirror needs the `clink` binary and is off unless\n  `MS_REPLY_CLINK=1`; suggestions never wait for it.\n- The Rust server does not implement the automation, people and\n  suggestion routes yet (see `docs/SERVER-PARITY.md` section 5a).\nautomations-editor-preview.png\nchat-automation-menu.png\nchat-reply-suggestions.png\nchat-skin-signal-dark.png\nchat-skin-signal-light.png\nchat-skin-t3-dark.png\nchat-skin-t3-light.png\nchat-skin-telegram-dark.png\nchat-skin-telegram-light.png\nchat-skin-whatsapp-dark.png\nchat-skin-whatsapp-light.png\nchat-word-suggestions.png\nphone-automation-ru.png\nphone-chat-draft.png\nphone-chat-list.png\nphone-contacts.png\nphone-more-sheet.png\nsettings-appearance.png\ntablet-chat-rail-ru.png",

The [review](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/pull/34#issuecomment-6111692095) asked for a universal, configurable mechanism instead, so this round replaces that screen with **automations**. Issue #31 becomes one preset (`reengage-dormant`) of that mechanism. The detection core from round 1 is kept.\n\nAn automation is **trigger → audience → conditions → action**. The triggers follow [konard/vk-bot](https://github.com/konard/vk-bot): `manual`, `schedule`, `incoming` (regex) and `chat-menu`. Safe mode (alias `debug`) is the default: a run only queues pre-filled drafts in each person's own chat. A draft is sent only after a confirmation, which the server enforces.\n\n## Every requirement, where it lives\n\nThe full mapping, sentence by sentence, is in [`docs/case-studies/issue-31/requirements.md`](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/blob/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31/requirements.md). A tie or no evidence falls back to \"вы\". `pattern:*` links labelled `address:informal/formal` add rules. |\n| Issue: safe or debug mode, one prefilled message at a time, sent after confirmation | `safe` (alias `debug`) is the default for every automation. Drafts appear in the chat and are sent from it or from `automations review`. `/api/automations/drafts/send` refuses without `confirm: true`. |\n| Triggers as in vk-bot instead of a separate screen; no separate chat | `automation/automations.js` handles manual, schedule, incoming and chat-menu triggers, and a scheduler starts with the server. Presets: `reengage-dormant`, `job-search`, `contract-search`, `greet-back`. |\n| Searchable, cross-referenced people; audiences merged and intersected from lists, communities and chats | `crm/people.js` keeps one entry per account. `sameAs` links join accounts; `crossReference` only suggests matches and never merges. Audiences combine `friends`, `chat:`, `community:`, `list:`, `person:`, `audience:` and `q:` atoms by union, `&` and `-`. VK and Telegram members are synced as `member:` links. |\n| Conditions such as 90 days | Conditions: `silentDays`, `mutual`, `personal`, `lastFrom`, `networks`, `cooldownDays`. The preview names why each person was left out. |\n| Test from the menu of any private or group chat | The ⚡ menu in every chat header has \"Test in this chat\" (conditions ignored) and \"Run with its conditions\". |\n| Reply autocomplete: deduplicated, sorted by frequency, word-by-word fallback from our own messages, link-cli | `replies/reply-graph.js` learns prompt → reply pairs from the archive and in real time. The graph is mirrored to `clink --serve` (`MS_REPLY_CLINK=1`); keystrokes are answered from memory because a link-cli query scans every link (see \"Alternatives\" in the plan). |\n| Associative stack: Links Notation text and binary, link-cli database | `storage/lino-store.js` stores the text form. `storage/binary-packet.js` and `doublets-archive.js` write binary packets in the link-cli archive layout; tests cross-check them against `links-notation`. |\n| Typing status in all messengers | VK `messages.setActivity`, Telegram `sendChatAction`, WhatsApp typing indicators and the web UIs. VK long-poll events show when the other person is typing. The web app, the desktop shell and the download page were all checked.\n\n- **Audit tooling.** `experiments/ui-audit.mjs` visits every view at desktop, tablet and phone widths, in light and dark, with `LOCALE=en` and `LOCALE=ru`. It reports horizontal overflow, clipped or ellipsised labels, controls under WCAG 2.2's 24×24 px target, overlapping controls, uneven rows and axe-core contrast violations. The last runs report no layout findings. The only finding left is four failed `vk.com` sticker requests (`ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR`) from external demo images. `experiments/issue-31-screenshots.mjs` regenerates every shot above.\n- **Wording** (Material 3 and Apple HIG): sentence case for buttons, headings and meta lines; plurals in each language (ICU subset); and `Intl` dates in the interface language. Networks appear by name (\"VK\", \"Telegram\", \"Email\", or \"Почта\" in Russian) instead of internal ids. Untouched preset automations show their name and description in the user's language.\n- **Chat list dates.** Rows show the time today, the weekday within the week, and the date after that, as messengers do. Before, a months-old chat showed only a time (\"4:10 AM\").\n- **Suggestions.** The word fallback shows three chips, like the Gboard and iOS QuickType strip, instead of eight. Whole replies used before are all still offered.\n- **Contacts.** Each contact is named by its messages (`senderName`; \"Аня user1001\" instead of \"user1001\"). The list is newest first and excludes the owner. The offline client returns the same list as `/api/contacts`.\n- **Desktop app.** The window opens in the app's own background colour instead of flashing white on a dark desktop. It is shown on `ready-to-show` and can be narrowed only to a phone's width (360 px), where the app switches to its bottom bar.\n- **Download page.** A card's size no longer wraps onto a line that starts with \"·\".\n\n## How to try\n\n```bash\nnode experiments/automations-spa-server.mjs 4791     # open http://localhost:4791\nnode experiments/automations-cli-roundtrip.mjs       # plan → safe run → review → plan again, on disk\nmeta-sovereign automations plan reengage-dormant     # preview from the CLI\n```\n\n## Tests\n\n`npm test` passes 839/839 locally (Node), and `i18n` also passes on Bun and Deno. Lint, Prettier and jscpd (5.1 %) pass too. New test files: `automations`, `automation-cli`, `automations-server`, `automation-api`, `automations-view`, `people`, `live-links`, `reply-graph`, `reply-service`, `reply-store-clink`, `doublets-archive`, `browser-sender`, `chat-view`, `appearance`, `aggregate` and `desktop-window`. `address-form`, `reengage`, `i18n` and `download-page` were extended. `experiments/merged-spa-smoke.mjs` opens the Chat, Automation and Greetings tabs in Chromium with no console errors.\n\nCI passes on the full Node / Bun / Deno × Ubuntu / macOS / Windows matrix. Two CI-only problems were fixed on the way:\n- **Windows:** `findClink` now looks for `clink.exe`, and its test builds paths with the host separator.\n- **Bun on macOS:** Bun uses the system's newer CLDR data there. It joins date and time with \"at\" / \"в\" and capitalises Russian weekdays, so the date tests accept both forms.\n- **Deno:** Deno 2 refuses npm releases younger than 24 h, so the `links-notation` and `lino-objects-codec` ranges start at `0.25.0` and `0.9.0`. The lockfile still installs the latest 0.25.2 and 0.9.2.\n\n## Known limits\n\n- Only VK reports when the other person is typing. The Telegram Bot API and WhatsApp Cloud API deliver no typing events, and WhatsApp can show typing only in reply to an incoming message.\n- Web-UI sending depends on each site's markup. It is tested against a fake browser session, not against the live sites.\n- The link-cli mirror needs the `clink` binary and is off unless `MS_REPLY_CLINK=1`.\n- With three or more SPA tabs in one sync room, the console shows WebRTC \"Failed to set remote answer sdp: Called in wrong state\". `sync/webrtc-transport.js` broadcasts offers and answers to every peer; this predates the PR and is unchanged by it.\n- The Rust server does not implement the automation, people and suggestion routes yet. Route parity is now 34 of 67 routes (51 %); see SERVER-PARITY section 5a.\n\nCase study: [`docs/case-studies/issue-31/`](https://github.com/link-foundation/meta-sovereign/tree/issue-31-5ccfae6dabce/docs/case-studies/issue-31).
